algorithm.description: Object algorithm used for wrapping. Accepted values are AES128 or AES256.

capabilities.description: String of capabilities granted to the object. Example: signPSS,decryptRSA.

delegated.description: String of delegated capabilities allowed for the object. Leave empty if none.

domains.description: String of domains the object is accessible from. Range or specific IDs.

input_file.description: Path to the input data filename.

output_file.description: Path to the output data filename.

wrap_key_file.description: Path to the wrap key filename.
